item.command:
/bin/sh -lc "cd /work && cat > count_not_functional.py << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv(\"handpump_survey.csv\")
# Column names have stray spaces; normalize them
df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]

status_col = df.columns[df.columns == \"Status\"][0]
print(f\"Using status column: '{status_col}'\")
print(df[status_col].value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())

not_functional = df[df[status_col].str.strip().str.lower() == \"not functional\"]
counts = (
    not_functional.groupby(\"Block\")
    .size()
    .rename(\"Not Functional\")
    .reset_index()
)
# Include blocks with zero not functional pumps
all_blocks = df[\"Block\"].str.strip().unique()
result = pd.DataFrame({\"Block\": all_blocks}).merge(counts, on=\"Block\", how=\"left\")
result[\"Not Functional\"] = result[\"Not Functional\"].fillna(0).astype(int)
result = result.sort_values([\"Not Functional\", \"Block\"], ascending=[False, True]).reset_index(drop=True)

print(\"\\nNot functional pumps per block:\")
print(result.to_string(index=False))
print(f\"\\nTotal not functional: {result['Not Functional'].sum()} of {len(df)} pumps\")
EOF
python3 count_not_functional.py"

**Notes**
